topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out that the building I call home is turning into a condo. The stability I thought I had is slipping away. Now, everything feels uncertain. What does this mean for my future here? The very walls that wrap around me might not be mine to stay in. I keep thinking, if I have to move, where will I go? The neighborhood, the community—they’ve become a part of me. Change is coming, and I’m not sure how to face it. The what-ifs are piling up faster than I can sort through them. I need to find out more, to understand what’s next. But right now, it all feels overwhelming.
